controls.reader_and_writer: same existing Qwen service, JSON action transport
controls.laya: original multilingual BASE; no operation training

selection_rule: Retain all first attempts and all histories. A concrete execution failure stops dispatch for diagnosis; semantic failure alone does not stop. No automatic replay.
costs: Original continuous ledger; report individual message deltas and local-controller work. Source scan and operation timings remain in native traces; full workload time is not production latency.
evaluation: Author source/answer/actual-state review; preserve partial/ambiguous/unsupported/failure categories. Four method paths are diagnostic, not independent families.
runtime_projection: Only current text, declared times, arriving source bodies/roles and normal Host state. Expected answers and named offline families are never passed to policy.
limitations: Authored synthetic development histories, not a held-out or external benchmark.
Tool log source fixtures are authored historical observations, not live sandbox actions.

E0 fixed baseline uses the common evidence-pool order (lexical original Sources, dense semantic retrieval), not the stronger standalone dense fixed4 benchmark baseline; add that matched baseline for main evaluation.
Single-slot and full inventory discovery remain initial implementation; multi-slot and incremental discovery pending.
checkpoint_selection: BASE only for E0. No seed/chosen checkpoint claims.
